beats.text: A D H D me. The front door to A D H D care in Australia.
Getting A D H D care in Australia is a maze.
The cost is hidden until after you have paid, and waited.
You get whoever is available. Not whoever fits.
Every clinician assesses you differently.
And at handover, prescriptions lapse without warning.
So people give up before the first booking.
We start with sixteen to twenty-five year olds in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane, seeking a diagnosis.
A D H D me is matching, not triage. Not the next free slot. The right person, for you.
A new parent in the postpartum period is matched with a G P who has perinatal experience.
Someone from a South Asian family, where A D H D is not talked about at home, is matched with a doctor who shares that background, and speaks Hindi and Urdu.
Someone afraid of being judged for wanting medication is matched with a clinician who uses plain language, and no judgement.
Postpartum. Cultural background. Stigma. The things a directory never asks.
Here is how a match is made. We ask about your life, not your postcode: your stage of life, your background and language, what you fear, and how you like to be spoken to.
We know every clinician the same way. We interview them first: what they have seen, who they do best with, how they work.
Two models run side by side. Transparent rules that score every factor, and a language model that reads the nuance in what you wrote. We test which earns its place.
After every consultation, five fit signals feed back: communication, collaboration, structure, scope, price and availability. The next match is better than the last.
You know your doctor fits before you meet. Diagnosis is faster and cheaper than the psychiatrist-only route. And the same clinician stays with you, at six, twelve and twenty-four months.
Costs are published before you book. Standard templates mean the same assessment everywhere. Script alerts mean no lapse at handover. And it is free for patients.
Why now? G Ps can now diagnose A D H D. Queensland is live. New South Wales and Victoria follow through twenty twenty-six.
More than a million Australians have A D H D. A quarter of a million are seeking care right now.
Free for patients. Clinicians subscribe for a steady flow of well matched patients.
We are live at A D H D me dot A U, with two G Ps in Sydney, and two matching models in test.
The right A D H D doctor should not be hard to find. Now, they are not.
A D H D me.
